description: A markedly draconic, long-lived people (lifespans of centuries) descended from dragon-blooded warriors who warred on the divine and were cursed (see the-wandering-curse). Each dragonkin is bound to one element, which shows in the color of their scales, shapes their temperament, and determines their power. Once flighted war-dragons, they can no longer take the old war-shape, and though their wings remain, the curse has bound them to functionlessness -- they can no longer fly. They retain their great strength and their elemental abilities, now leashed to defense alone. A warrior people forbidden war, they have become the world's wanderers and traders, moving goods, craft, and news along the endless road.
rules: Every dragonkin is born to a single element -- water, earth, air, fire, or spirit. The element determines three things: (1) the COLOR of their scales, (2) their TEMPERAMENT, and (3) the nature of their POWER. Brilliance tracks strength: the stronger the individual's power, the more vivid and luminous their coloring; the weak are dull and muted. Spirit is exceedingly rare. All powers are bound by the Wandering Curse -- usable freely in defense, but any aggressive use deepens the curse (see the-wandering-curse). They cannot fly and cannot take the old war-shape; strength and elemental gift remain.

details.Water: Palette: cool blues. Temperament: calm, adaptable, deep-feeling, yielding but relentless. Power: shaping water, currents, mist and ice; defensively, walls of water, quenching, dragging a foe off balance.
details.Earth: Palette: earthy browns and oranges. Temperament: steady, patient, stubborn, protective, slow to move and slow to stop. Power: stone and soil, tremors, raising walls and cover, the strength of the land; the great shielders.
details.Air: Palette: wan whites and thistle-greys, faintly iridescent. Temperament: restless, free, quick, changeable, aloof. Power: wind and pressure; deflecting arrows, buffeting attackers back, stealing breath -- defense as deflection.
details.Fire: Palette: brilliant crimson and gold, ember-bright (distinct from earth's duller ochres). Temperament: passionate, quick-tempered, fierce, warm, impulsive -- the element most tempted to aggression, and thus most endangered by the curse. Power: heat and flame; defensively, walls of fire, fireproof skin, warmth against the killing cold of the road.
details.Spirit: Palette: hues of silver, exceedingly rare. Temperament: otherworldly, set-apart, serene or haunted. Power: odd and uncanny -- foresight (glimpses of what comes) and mending (the healing of wounds). Warding. A spirit-born is treasured and a little feared by their own.
details.Wings: Every dragonkin still bears their wings, but the curse has bound them to functionlessness -- they cannot lift a body from the ground and cannot fly. What remains is defensive: a wing can be mantled as a physical barrier, a shield of scaled membrane against blade, arrow, wind, or weather. Like everything the curse touched, the wing was made for war and flight and is now permitted only to protect.
details.Physical traits: Scaled skin in the element's hue (across parts of the body), draconic eyes, ridges or small horns, and bound wings (see above). Great strength beyond a human's. The brilliance of the scales advertises power to any who know how to read it.
details.Lifespan: Centuries. She will wander lifetimes; a mortal who joins and is cursed will still age and die while she walks on -- a second impossibility layered under the first.
details.Culture: Wanderers and traders by necessity. Their defense-only strength makes them superb caravan-guards, and the endless road made them merchants, artisans, and bearers of news between realms. Worldly, resourceful, and weary; proud of their craft and quietly grieving what they were. Organized in clan-bands under a leader (see the negotiating tribe-leader, to come in characters).
details.Open (Characters stage): The love interest's element -- a choice with real thematic weight (e.g. a spirit-born who foresees the tragedy; a fire-born most tempted by the curse; an earth-born who most aches for a home). Additional elements could be introduced later if the story needs them; the current set is five.
